title: Rental Estimate in the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Authorization Hold
content:
**Rental estimate clause.** The Bluegate Moving Truck Rental hold rental estimate depends on the booked days, counted as the calendar days from the scheduled pickup date to the scheduled return date:

- a contract booked to come back on its scheduled pickup date adds **40** miles at the class per-mile rate to the hold;
- a contract booked for two or more days adds the class base rate for each booked day after the first;
- a contract booked for one day adds no rental estimate.

The estimate is an amount added to the hold on its own; it is not part of the card deposit.

## Three cases (hypothetical Bluegate Cargo Van contracts; per-mile rate 0.89, class base rate 24.95)

| Booking | Booked days | Rental estimate added to the hold |
|---|---|---|
| Pickup and return scheduled on 4 May | 0 | 35.60 — 40 miles at 0.89 |
| Pickup 4 May, return 5 May | 1 | None |
| Pickup 4 May, return 7 May | 3 | 49.90 — 2 booked days after the first at 24.95 |
